com.vector.cfg.persistency.location

Interface IPersistencyLocationPublished

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.Comparable<IPersistencyLocationPublished>

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value={GENERATOR_INTERNAL_ADDONS,AUTOMATION_IF})
public interface IPersistencyLocationPublished
extends java.lang.Comparable<IPersistencyLocationPublished>
    A IPersistencyLocationPublished represents a location which stores its data in an ARXML file. Instances of this type can be created by using the IPersistencyLocationCreatorPublished.

    Remark: The IPersistencyLocationCreatorPublished guarantees that only one instance exists per file.

    There are the following methods to create model elements within a location (See JavaDoc for more details):
    • createUniqueMappedAutosarElement(Class, AsrPath)
    • createUniqueMappedAutosarObject(Class, MIObject, String)
    • createUniqueMappedAutosarPackage(AsrPath)

      • createUniqueMappedAutosarElement

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nonnull
<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIARElement> T createUniqueMappedAutosarElement(@Nonnull
                                                                                                                                    java.lang.Class<T> mdfType,
                                                                                                                                    @Nonnull
                                                                                                                                    AsrPath parentPackagePath)
        This method creates an new instance of the specified AUTOSAR element type, adds it to the model tree below the specified parent package and maps it uniquely to this location. If the parent package doesn't exist it will be created too.
        Parameters:
        mdfType - is the MDF type of the new object
        parentPackagePath - is an AUTOSAR path specifying the parent package of the new object
        Returns:
        The new autosar element

      • createUniqueMappedAutosarPackage

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nonnull
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIARPackage createUniqueMappedAutosarPackage(@Nonnull
                                                                                                                      AsrPath packagePath)
        This method creates an new instance of the specified AUTOSAR package, adds it to the model tree and maps it uniquely to this location. All non-existing parent packages will be created too.
        Parameters:
        packagePath - is an AUTOSAR path specifying the new package
        Returns:
